provenance.source: PR #9421 Enable unit testing versioned models, merged 2024-01-29
provenance.note: the line the PR rewrites decides whether a schema edit re-parses the nodes that reference a changed model, but it only looks at the previously parsed node being versioned, so a model that gains versions for the first time leaves its referencing nodes on the stale parse; the base carries the same gap behind a narrower condition, so the PR neither introduces nor repairs it, and the later fix adds elem.get("versions") to the test

bugs.note: the gate is the old node's own versioned flag, so a model that becomes versioned is not counted as a change that its referencing nodes must re-read; the fix also tests the new schema entry for versions
